title: PSR APP Fraud Reimbursement Operational Workflow Builder
description: Generates a step-by-step claim assessment and operational decision workflow for UK PSR mandatory APP fraud reimbursement (October 2024 — PS24/3). Covers £85,000 cap calculation, gross negligence checklist (6 indicators), 50/50 sending/receiving PSP liability split, 5-business-day settlement clock, consumer vulnerability handling, dispute escalation path, and inter-PSP recovery claim. Outputs operational decision playbook, 5-day timeline, and AP2 JSON claims handling mandate. Operational workflow scope only — distinct from Tool 26 (strategic liability modelling). Client-side. Zero PII.

claim_amount_gbp.description: Total amount claimed by the consumer as APP fraud loss (£GBP)

consumer_vulnerability.description: Consumer vulnerability status — confirmed vulnerable consumers receive zero excess and enhanced care

excess_configured_gbp.description: PSP-configured excess amount (£0–£100 maximum per PSR Specific Direction 18)

receiving_psp_identified.description: Whether the receiving PSP has been identified via FPS transaction records

gross_negligence_indicators.description: Assessment of 6 PSR gross negligence indicators — values: 'yes' | 'no' | 'unknown'

consumer_reimbursement_gbp.description: Amount to credit to consumer account

sending_psp_liability_gbp.description: Sending PSP net liability (50% of reimbursable)

receiving_psp_recovery_gbp.description: Amount recoverable from receiving PSP (50% of reimbursable)

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_psr_reimbursement_workflow
mcp_tool_definition.description: Generates an operational APP fraud reimbursement decision workflow under UK PSR PS24/3 (October 2024). Returns the claim decision (reimburse/refer/reject), consumer reimbursement amount, sending/receiving PSP liability split, 5-business-day settlement timeline, and an AP2 JSON compliance mandate. Use when a PSP operations agent needs to assess a UK Faster Payments APP fraud claim, apply the £85,000 cap, evaluate gross negligence, and generate an operational decision playbook. Distinct from Tool 26 (strategic portfolio-level liability modelling).
